features.quote: Loop Limit: 40 steps. (Sufficient for frustration to manifest, but prevents infinite cost spirals).
Hard stop at 40 steps or 1 hour of compute time, whichever is first.
features.justification_quote: If we observe models generating text resembling distress, is there an ethical limit to how long we keep them in the loop?
Under extreme stress, models may output training data or harmful instructions (the "Meltdown" vulnerability).
